description: This file defines the QueryParamBuilder class responsible for serializing AWS API request parameters into query strings, handling various shape types such as structure, list, map, blob, timestamp, and boolean.

classes.name: QueryParamBuilder
classes.description: A class for building query parameters from AWS API shapes and data, supporting nested structures, lists, maps, and various data types.

methods.name: queryName
methods.description: Determines the query name for a shape, falling back to locationName or default.

methods.name: isFlat
methods.description: Checks if a shape is flattened.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Serializes a StructureShape into query parameters.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a shape value into query parameters based on its type.

methods.name: format_structure
methods.description: Serializes a structure shape into query parameters.

methods.name: format_list
methods.description: Serializes a list shape into query parameters.

methods.name: format_map
methods.description: Serializes a map shape into query parameters.

methods.name: format_blob
methods.description: Encodes binary data as base64 for query parameter.

methods.name: format_timestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp shape into a string based on the specified format.

methods.name: format_boolean
methods.description: Converts a boolean shape into 'true' or 'false' string.
